overview.description: The TCW High Yield Bond ETF (HYBX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high yield fixed income. The fund is actively managed to invest in global government and corporate securities rated as high yield, within a broad range of maturities. HYBX was launched on Feb 1, 1989 and is issued by TCW.
